name: extractfeat
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 'extractfeat': the features of the sequences of a file (any input format of seqret with features) that pass the source, type, sense, score, tag and value filters, as sequences with the sequence before and after them.
short: EMBOSS extractfeat: the features of a sequence file (filters on source, type, sense, score, tag, value; before / after, join, names and descriptions) as sequences in FASTA or another output format; equals extractfeat 6.6.0 on 1 000 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 extractfeat: the features of the sequences of a file that pass the filters are extracted as sequences named SEQUENCE_START_END (with featInName also _TYPE) and described by [type] and the tags of describe, optionally with the sequence before and after the feature and the parts of a join as one sequence (join). Equals the installed program on 1 000 runs (every input format with features, every filter, before / after / join, 22 output formats, damaged files).

sequenceText: The text of the sequence output file (FASTA or the output format).
messages: What the library printed (warnings and errors).

errors: The sequence cannot be empty
Unable to read sequence ... (no sequence in the file)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault, and an output format this port does not write, are refused

example.title: The mRNA and exon features of an EMBL entry
example.prompt: Extract the mRNA and exon features of this EMBL entry, with the feature type in the sequence name.

input.sequence:
ID   X1; SV 1; linear; genomic DNA; STD; UNC; 60 BP.
XX
AC   X1;
XX
DE   test
XX
FH   Key             Location/Qualifiers
FH
FT   mRNA            1..40
FT   exon            45..55
SQ   Sequence 60 BP; 15 A; 15 C; 15 G; 15 T; 0 other;
     acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt        60
//

example.note: The name of a feature sequence is the sequence name with the first and last position of the feature; the description is the type in brackets, the tags of describe and the description of the sequence.

name: coderet
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 'coderet': the coding sequences, messenger RNAs, translations and non-coding regions of the sequences of a file with feature tables.
short: EMBOSS coderet: the CDS, mRNA, translation (the /translation tag) and non-coding regions of a nucleotide sequence file with feature tables, the log of the counts; equals coderet 6.6.0 on 1 000 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 coderet: from the nucleotide sequences of a file with feature tables the coding sequences (CDS features, joins as one sequence), the messenger RNAs (mRNA features), the translations (the translation tag of the CDS features) and the non-coding regions (what the CDS, mRNA and exon features leave) are written; the tool returns the log (the counts of every sequence), the files by name (NAME.cds, NAME.mrna, NAME.prot, NAME.noncoding, NAME the first sequence in lower case) and the messages. Equals the installed program on 1 000 runs.

log: The log of the program: the counts of CDS, mRNA, non-coding features and translations of every sequence.
messages: What the library printed (warnings and errors).

errors: The sequence cannot be empty
Unable to read sequence ... (no sequence in the file) and Sequence is not nucleic (a protein file)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault, and an output format this port does not write, are refused

example.title: The coding sequence and translation of an EMBL entry
example.prompt: Get the CDS and its translation from this EMBL entry.

input.sequence:
ID   X1; SV 1; linear; genomic DNA; STD; UNC; 60 BP.
XX
AC   X1;
XX
DE   test
XX
FH   Key             Location/Qualifiers
FH
FT   CDS             join(3..12,20..29)
FT                   /translation="MKV"
SQ   Sequence 60 BP; 15 A; 15 C; 15 G; 15 T; 0 other;
     acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt        60
//

example.note: The sequences are named ACCESSION_cds_N and ACCESSION_pro_N in lower case; the CDS of a join is its parts one after the other.

name: showfeat
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 'showfeat': the features of the sequences of a file as lines of ASCII graphics under a scale.
short: EMBOSS showfeat: the features of a sequence file as lines of ASCII graphics (filters, sort, join, collapse, strand / source / position / type / tags, annotation ranges, HTML); equals showfeat 6.6.0 on 1 000 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 showfeat: the features of the sequences of a file as lines of ASCII graphics under a scale, one line per feature, filtered by source, type, tag and value, sorted, with the strand, source, positions, type and tags and the annotation ranges. Equals the installed program on 1 000 runs.

text: The text of the output file.
messages: What the library printed (warnings and errors).

errors: The sequence cannot be empty
Unable to read sequence ... (no sequence in the file)
Bad range value ... / Odd integer(s) in range specification (annotation)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault is refused

example.title: The features of an EMBL entry, 30 columns wide
example.prompt: Draw the features of this EMBL entry on 30 columns, joins on one line, with strand and tags.

input.sequence:
ID   X1; SV 1; linear; genomic DNA; STD; UNC; 60 BP.
XX
AC   X1;
XX
DE   test
XX
FH   Key             Location/Qualifiers
FH
FT   CDS             join(3..12,20..29)
FT                   /gene="g1"
FT   mRNA            1..40
SQ   Sequence 60 BP; 15 A; 15 C; 15 G; 15 T; 0 other;
     acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt        60
//

example.note: The scale line shows the width and the length of the sequence; a forward feature starts with | and ends with >, a reverse one starts with < and ends with |.

name: featreport
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 'featreport': the first feature table of a feature file reported for a sequence in a report format.
short: EMBOSS featreport: the feature table of a feature file reported for a sequence (gff default; every report format, joins and tags for the feature formats); equals featreport 6.6.0 on 1 000 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 featreport: the first feature table of a feature file in any feature format is reported for a sequence in a report format (gff default; gff3, embl, genbank, pir, swiss and dasgff are written by the feature writers of the library, the others list start, end, strand and score), with the report qualifiers and the range of the features. Equals the installed program on 1 000 runs.

report: The text of the report file.
messages: What the library printed (warnings and errors).

errors: The sequence cannot be empty
The features cannot be empty
Bad value for '-features' and no more retries (the text is no feature file)
Report format ... needs 7 tags (diffseq) / not supported for ... sequences
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault is refused

example.title: The features of an EMBL entry as an Excel table
example.prompt: Report the features of this EMBL entry in the excel report format.

input.sequence:
ID   X1; SV 1; linear; genomic DNA; STD; UNC; 60 BP.
XX
AC   X1;
XX
DE   test
XX
FH   Key             Location/Qualifiers
FH
FT   mRNA            1..40
FT   exon            45..55
SQ   Sequence 60 BP; 15 A; 15 C; 15 G; 15 T; 0 other;
     acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt        60
//
input.features:
ID   X1; SV 1; linear; genomic DNA; STD; UNC; 60 BP.
XX
AC   X1;
XX
DE   test
XX
FH   Key             Location/Qualifiers
FH
FT   mRNA            1..40
FT   exon            45..55
SQ   Sequence 60 BP; 15 A; 15 C; 15 G; 15 T; 0 other;
     acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt        60

output.report:

X1	1	40	0.000	+
X1	45	55	0.000	+

example.note: The excel format has no header; the other formats print the run date and the command line.

name: twofeat
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 'twofeat': pairs of features of a sequence in a required relation (overlap, distance, sense) reported.
short: EMBOSS twofeat: pairs of an A and a B feature (source, type, sense, score, tag, value) of a sequence file in a required overlap / distance / sense, reported (table default); equals twofeat 6.6.0 on 1 000 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 twofeat: the features of the sequences of a file that match the criteria of feature A and of feature B are paired when they are in the required overlap, distance (minRange .. maxRange from the nearest, left, right or furthest ends) and sense, and the pairs are reported as a feature covering both (tags startA endA startB endB) or as the two features (twoOut), in the report format. Equals the installed program on 1 000 runs.

report: The text of the report file.
messages: What the library printed (warnings and errors).

errors: The sequence cannot be empty
Unable to read sequence ... (no sequence in the file)
Unknown Overlap / rangetype / sense code
Report format ... needs 7 tags (diffseq)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault, and the opposite sense on opposite strands (a fatal error of the library), are refused

example.title: A mRNA and an exon of an EMBL entry
example.prompt: Report the pairs of a mRNA feature and an exon feature of this EMBL entry in the excel format.

input.sequence:
ID   X1; SV 1; linear; genomic DNA; STD; UNC; 60 BP.
XX
AC   X1;
XX
DE   test
XX
FH   Key             Location/Qualifiers
FH
FT   mRNA            1..40
FT   exon            45..55
SQ   Sequence 60 BP; 15 A; 15 C; 15 G; 15 T; 0 other;
     acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt        60
//

output.report:
SeqName	Start	End	Score	Strand	starta	enda	startb	endb
X1	1	55	0.000	+	1	40	45	55

example.note: The feature that covers a pair runs from the first start to the last end and carries the positions of both features as tags.
